executionPlan: Moved avatarLook from components/game to components/avatar as a once-per-root, permanent, idempotent module. Made the covered-triangle mask pose independent (bindMatrix space). Hero schedules it at idle. Game calls the same function (no-op). Verified with headless Chrome CDP under SwiftShader, before/after builds in a copy, vitest, lint.
summary: The clothing fix now lives in components/avatar/avatarLook.ts (apply is once per root and never reverted). The hero schedules it at idle and the game's call is a no-op. A 3-cycle Play/Exit probe shows one shirt material, one padded map and stable uuids. Hero before/after at rest and in a dance gesture shows the collar, sleeve and hem specks gone with nothing else changed. The apply costs about 265 ms (cold run 973 ms) under software GL in dev, so it is deferred to idle. It is a single long task, not chunked.

criteria.criterion: The hero applies the fix once to the shared avatar when it loads, and the game relies on that shared state or applies it idempotently, so entering and exiting the game neither duplicates nor reverts the fix; a probe over 3 Play/Exit cycles shows one shirt material copy, one padded texture and stable uuids.

criteria.evidence: Total about 264 ms warm and 973 ms cold under SwiftShader in the dev build. Split measured on the synchronous version: mask about 135 ms, dilation about 135 to 157 ms. assumptions: Pre-fix hero 'before' frames were produced by temporarily disabling the Avatar effect, restored afterwards; temporary timing instrumentation was also removed (grep TEMP clean).
vitest.config.mts needed a one-line include for components/avatar tests, which is outside the listed files but required for the unit tests to run.
Dev-build software-GL timings overstate real-GPU-machine CPU cost; the apply is CPU only so a real device should be faster, but that was not measured.
decisionsProposed: Record in ADR-002: the shared avatar's look fix lives in components/avatar/avatarLook.ts, is applied once and permanently per cached scene, and the game must not revert it. Mask is computed in bindMatrix space, so it is pose independent and can be deferred.
lessonsProposed: Measure coverage rays in a skinned mesh's bindMatrix space instead of the posed skeleton, so heavy mask work can be deferred without a bind-pose precondition.
When two modes share one cached three.js scene, apply fixes permanently and idempotently (WeakSet) instead of apply/restore pairs.
Gesture before/after shots: use a button click plus a 2.5 s wait; 1.3 s after click still shows the idle pose.
